body:
## Day 1. Still breathing.

Up at first light. Ran the morning routine without cutting corners. **Water secured before coffee**, which has never happened before.

- Ten pages read. Supplies for the mind.
- Walked the river route. Grey, quiet, no trouble.
- Radioed home. Line still works.

> Dignified nod for: walking it when the sky said stay in. Supplies don't gather themselves.
